subject.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat

question: Should ordinary Oracle browser runs always normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat, while explicit resumes of existing Work conversations fail closed?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and well-proven, but it establishes a user-visible mode policy that no maintainer discussion has explicitly confirmed.

options.title: Adopt Chat-only normalization
options.body: After a narrow rebase, ordinary runs switch or reset to Chat and explicit Work resumes return the proposed clear error.

options.title: Add an explicit mode contract
options.body: Pause this PR and define configuration or model semantics for choosing Chat versus Work rather than normalizing unconditionally.

options.title: Preserve attached-page mode
options.body: Decline the guard and continue operating in whichever ChatGPT mode the selected page or tab currently exposes.

recommendation.title: Adopt Chat-only normalization
recommendation.body: After a narrow rebase, ordinary runs switch or reset to Chat and explicit Work resumes return the proposed clear error.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the central browser startup, navigation, attachment, resume, and recovery architecture.
